answer: Attention-Decay Ledger.** Each identity must spend a scored minimum of verified micro-tasks per epoch to stay active, tracked through a jade audit trail that logs each session's timing and sequence. Duplicates force the attacker to split finite human attention across many sessions, and the orchard of idle accounts decays before reactivation fees clear. Sustained throughput costs the attacker hours no bot can fake, and a glacier-slow reactivation queue makes each revival expensive enough to make mass identity farming unprofitable.
